title: Keto Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan-inspired dish made with tender lamb and a blend of spices, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the onion. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for 10 more minutes.
Garnish with parsley before serving, if desired.
Serve hot over cauliflower rice or zucchini noodles for a keto-friendly side dish.
